changes: 6 of the 800 test documents. Word boxes re-laid-out into lines; no other edits. CORD's annotation covers only the item and total area, so these texts have no store header, address or date. Note on cord-test-13: the reader's "total" is the pre-tax TOTAL line (46.636); the dataset's total_price label points at the GRAND TOTAL line, which the reader proposes as grand_total (51.300). Both are in the text; gold checks both.
